voices.name: l00
voices.text: Sufis dress in white, <#0.2#> and spin.
voices.caption: Sufis dress in white, and spin.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: One palm to the sky, <#0.2#> one to the earth.
voices.caption: One palm to the sky, one to the earth.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: They turn, and turn, <#0.3#> until thought stops.
voices.caption: They turn, and turn, until thought stops.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: The self disappears, <#0.2#> and it's said they become one with God.
voices.caption: The self disappears, and it's said they become one with God.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Awakening comes <#0.2#> through the body, not the head.
voices.caption: Awakening comes through the body, not the head.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: Today, <#0.2#> dance to just one song.
voices.caption: Today, dance to just one song.
